headline: Tatum's free throws finish a 22-point comeback
dek: Down 22 in the first half, Boston won it on Tatum’s late free throws.
three: Tatum: 24 points, 10 of 12 at the line
Scored the first 10 of a 16–0 run, then the go-ahead free throws.
Down 22 in the second, then won the fourth 23–13
Tatum and White combined for 43 of 98.
Won it at the line and in the fourth
Free throws made 24–13; blocks 10–4. Boston held Toronto to 13 in the fourth.
